findings.issue: hγ_meas : Measurable γ (global) is stronger than needed. It is only used at line 179 to supply integrability of the truncated integrand over sub-intervals of the window, all contained in Icc (t₀-r) (t₀+r), where hγ_cont already yields (ae-strong) measurability. The global hypothesis is redundant given hγ_cont.

summary: The left slit-plane hypothesis is quantified over an anchor variable the proof never varies, making it stronger than needed; the global measurability hypothesis duplicates what the window continuity already gives.
